people.name: Ehud
people.line: Left-handed Benjamite judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression

translations.web: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.
translations.bsb: And Ehud reached with his left hand, pulled the sword from his right thigh, and plunged it into Eglon’s belly.
translations.kjv: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
